description: Normal-speed real browser recording. Full DSH navigation first; only model waiting is omitted. Stable results are freshly recorded for reading. No accelerated clips, subsecond inserts, UI resizing or synthesized motion.
editing_help: Per scene keep may be [{start:0.5,end:3.2,speed:1},{start:8,end:12,speed:1.5}] in actual capture seconds. Ranges must be chronological, nonoverlapping and within capture. Initial time before first frame is omitted. languages may override by language then scene name, e.g. languages.en.skill={keep:[...],speed:1}. capture.json marks are preserved in verification for choosing cuts; cuts are never inferred automatically.
